gen-gf-noto-sans-cypriot-fs-literata: Noto Sans Cypriot keeps its counters connected to the space around them, a contemporary sans-serif with low contrast in its strokes. Literata, a serif, tightens gently at curve tops and settles into long reading.
gen-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoan-fs-literat: Noto Sans Cypro Minoan flings its e open wide. It handles crisp, modern headings, while Literata, a serif with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, handles the sustained reading.
gen-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-rohingya-fs-lite: Literata reads as a bookish text serif, its curved letters showing wide, unclosed mouths and thin joins that never turn spindly. Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya, with distinct gaps in c, e and s, does the crisp announcing, and the serif does the patient talking.
gen-gf-noto-sans-hatran-fs-literata: Round letters that look cupped, not clenched, define Noto Sans Hatran, a sans-serif with low stroke contrast and an approachable face. Literata follows with a serif's modest stem-to-hairline ratio, so the two feel friendly and sophisticated at once.
gen-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional-pahlavi-f: Literata brings a bookish, sophisticated serif, with a modest but readable shift in weight across every curve it draws. Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi sits beside it, clean and contemporary, its wide-open curves staying distinct.
gen-gf-noto-sans-javanese-fs-literata: Soft, restrained, and tidy: Noto Sans Javanese stops its terminals short of curling back in, with low contrast throughout. Literata, a text serif, adds sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones beneath it.
gen-gf-noto-sans-kawi-fs-literata: Modern in its wide-mouthed round letters, Noto Sans Kawi draws horizontals slightly slimmer than its verticals, with low contrast overall. Literata, a bookish text serif with sturdy thin lines, gives the pair its warmth.
gen-gf-noto-sans-linear-a-fs-literata: Literata sets a bookish, sophisticated text serif tone, with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones. Noto Sans Linear A is the clean, professional counterpart, its curves never closing back on themselves.
gen-gf-noto-sans-linear-b-fs-literata: Contemporary in feel, Noto Sans Linear B leaves wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, with low contrast between strokes. Literata, a classic serif, carries a long page with a small, steady thick-thin difference.
gen-gf-noto-sans-manichaean-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and sophisticated, its curved letters opening wide. Noto Sans Manichaean, with large entrances into each letter, adds a mild stress in the o and e, and the pairing would stay approachable across pages.
